text.en: 1. This Order is the Interpretation (Currency Act — Fees) Order 2022 and comes into operation on 31 January 2022.

heading.en: Fees for refund of face value of IBNS stained currency notes

text.en: 3. A fee of $0.30 per piece of currency note is payable to the Authority where the Authority refunds the face value of IBNS stained currency notes under section 19(2) of the Currency Act 1967.
4. The Authority may waive or reduce, wholly or in part, the fee mentioned in paragraph 3.
